author: ElderBane
body:
IGN - ElderBane

Reason banned:

Hacking - Speed. On September 29, 2014 3:01:09 PM GMT by the Moderator Zeusy.

My ban was not false and I admit that I was using a speed hack, it has been 7 months now and I feel that my ban should be lifted because I feel like I have learned that I should not of been hacking, it ruins the fun of the game. I know that if I do hack once more, I'll be gone from the sever forever and I don't want that to happen. This was the first and only time I've been banned from a sever and I really don't like not playing with my friends because I'm banned.

I hope that you will give me one more chance and I promise I will no hack again.
